description: This file defines a configurable parser for cron schedule expressions, including options for different time fields, descriptor handling, and parsing logic for cron syntax and descriptors.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: A configurable cron schedule parser with methods to parse cron expressions.

classes.name: SpecSchedule
classes.description: Represents a parsed cron schedule with specific time fields and location.

methods.name: NewParser
methods.description: Creates a new Parser with specified options, ensuring only one optional field is set.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a cron expression string into a Schedule object, handling optional fields, time zones, and descriptors.

methods.name: normalizeFields
methods.description: Normalizes and fills in default values for cron fields based on parser options.

methods.name: ParseStandard
methods.description: Parses standard 5-field cron expressions or descriptors into a Schedule.
